text:
sana: Heads-up — console alert: sudden spike in heartbeat sample counts for SSE streams after fallback routing change. quota alert triggered for multiple tenants. :eyes:

mike: Can you paste an example?

sana: Logs: ```[2026-03-20T12:03:21Z] conn_id=abc123 route=primary sample=1 heartbeat_ms=110
[2026-03-20T12:03:24Z] conn_id=abc123 route=fallback sample=1 heartbeat_ms=95
[2026-03-20T12:03:27Z] conn_id=abc123 route=primary sample=1 heartbeat_ms=108```

carla: That looks like the same connection getting counted multiple times across route changes. Is the console aggregating by (conn_id, route)?

ben: Yep. Console aggregation key currently = conn_id + route. When we swap route we end up double-counting the same session.

sana: Observed pattern: sticky route lost -> opaque proxy resubscribes -> resume path attaches both old and new route tags briefly. Console treats them as separate samples.

mike: Quick mitigation: drop samples where meta.resume=true and last_seen < 30s. Edge-proxy could add that logic. :thinking_face:

carla: I prefer avoiding runtime heuristics. We should de-duplicate in console by conn_id within a small sliding window (e.g., 60s). Less risk to runtime behaviour.

ben: Console-side de-dupe will add state & CPU. Back-of-envelope shows ~5% CPU increase at peak for current clusters. Worth it?

sana: Tradeoffs noted. Another option: add a canonical sample_session_id header at ingress, set once per connection lifecycle, and use that in aggregation. That reduces console work.

mike: If ingress sets `x-sample-session` and proxies propagate it, console aggregation key -> sample_session_id which is stable across route swaps. Nice.

deploy-bot: edge-proxy/canary deploy 2026-03-20T13:00: deployed to 10% :white_check_mark:

carla: Implementation plan: 1) Edge: emit `x-sample-session` on connection open; 2) Proxy: preserve header on resubscribe/resume; 3) Console: prefer sample_session_id for aggregation, fallback to conn_id; 4) UI: surface sampled fraction + last_route in trace view.

ben: I'll spike the console de-dupe memory cost and post numbers here. If sample_session_id is safe, console change is light.

mike: I'll add ingress PR to generate session ids (uuid4) and docs for header semantics. Sample header example: `x-sample-session: 1c3f2a9e-...`

sana: Can we also add telemetry tag `route.swap=true` for the window so we can filter noisy periods?

carla: Yes, add that to events from proxy on handoff. Will help alerting.

ben: Tests: replay recorded logs where same conn_id reports multiple route tags -> verify console counts only once when sample_session_id present. Also verify fallback: no header -> console falls back to old behaviour.

mike: Suggest doing a 1% canary for the header and console aggregation change, monitor alert rate & CPU for 24h, then ramp.

sana: Action items:
- sana: open infra issue with stack trace & sample logs
- mike: PR for ingress header (canary 1%)
- ben: spike & PR for console aggregation change
- carla: add route.swap telemetry and UI change ticket

carla: assigning to @ben @mike @sana. :white_check_mark:

sana: Thanks — will update the incident thread if alerts change. If anyone sees unexpected quota drops, ping here. :pray:
